name: Alert - Hosts with High CPU during Last 15 mins

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor" "_Total"
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "PercentProcessorTime" as procTime
| timeslice 1m 
| avg(procTime) as AvgProcTime by host,_timeslice 
// High CPU Threshold: 80%
| where AvgProcTime>= 80
| count as DataPoints by host 
// Second threshold: The cpu is high for at least 10 minutes within the last 15mins
| where DataPoints >= 10

description: Schedule this alert to run for every 15 mins and for the last 15 minutes. Alert thresholds can be changed in the query.
